newsitem.title: EGYPT: Pyramisa Hotels and Resorts to raise capital.
newsitem.headline: Pyramisa Hotels and Resorts to raise capital.

text.p: Pyramisa Hotels and Resorts said on Thursday it will seek to raise its capital by 40 million pounds ($11.7 million) by public subscription to 150 million pounds.
It said in a statement published in al-Akhbar newspaper that the capital increase would be distributed among two million shares with a value of 20 pounds each.

Current shareholders would be given priority in the subscription, which will seek to raise half the nominal value between January 12 to February 16. The second half of the subscription will close in the second part of May.
If the offering is not covered it will be extended to February 25 for initial subscribers.
